scripts.setup: bun install && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && (test -f WORKFLOW.md || cp WORKFLOW.md.example WORKFLOW.md)
scripts.configure: bun run setup && bun run src/cli/configure.ts
scripts.start:telegram: bun run setup && bun --env-file=.env run src/cli/startLocal.ts --bot=telegram
scripts.start:feishu: bun run setup && bun --env-file=.env run src/cli/startLocal.ts --bot=feishu
scripts.release:package:check: bun run scripts/build-release.cjs --output build/release-check && SYMHARIX_HOME=build/release-check-home build/release-check/SymHarix/bin/symharix version && SYMHARIX_HOME=build/release-check-home build/release-check/SymHarix/bin/symharix help
scripts.release:check: bun run security:audit && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run runtime:check && bun run release:package:check
